# Extraction of markers from the most common haplotypes
According to the tree in 2024-01-19 for COI and the 
haplotype network in 2024-01-17. 
```{bash, collapse = TRUE}
if [ ! -d Samp28S_farionis ]; then mkdir Samp28S_farionis; fi
for i in $(cat ../2024-01-19/farionis.txt); do
  if [ ! -e Samp28S_farionis/${i}_28S.fa ]; then
    BAM=../2023-10-02/BAM_lsrDNA_MT_Cpse/${i}.bam
    samtools consensus -r lsrDNA_MT_Cpse $BAM -A --P-het 0 \
                         -l 2000 -a --show-del yes --show-ins no | \
    sed "s/>lsrDNA_MT_Cpse/>${i}/" >> Samp28S_farionis/${i}_28S.fa
  fi
done
if [ ! -e farSamp28S.fa ]; then cat Samp28S_farionis/*.fa > farSamp28S.fa; fi

if [ ! -d Samp28S_pseudo ]; then mkdir Samp28S_pseudo; fi
for i in $(cat ../2024-01-19/pseudo.txt); do
  if [ ! -e Samp28S_pseudo/${i}_28S.fa ]; then
    BAM=../2023-10-02/BAM_lsrDNA_MT_Cpse/${i}.bam
    samtools consensus -r lsrDNA_MT_Cpse $BAM -A --P-het 0 \
                         -l 2000 -a --show-del yes --show-ins no | \
    sed "s/>lsrDNA_MT_Cpse/>${i}/" >> Samp28S_pseudo/${i}_28S.fa
  fi
done
if [ ! -e pseSamp28S.fa ]; then cat Samp28S_pseudo/*.fa > pseSamp28S.fa; fi
```

```{r}

suppressMessages(library(Biostrings))

writeXStringSet(pseSamp28S, "pseSamp28S.fa")
```

## Obtain the sequences of GeneBank 
```{bash, collapse=TRUE}

# From ENA:
if [ ! -d Genbank ]; then mkdir Genbank; fi
if [ ! -e Genbank/Crepi28SENA.fa ]; then
   if [ ! -e Genbank/INFO_accessions.txt ]; then
   ## COI
      PORTAL="https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/portal/api/search?"
      RESULT="result=sequence&"
      QUERY="query=tax_tree(334452)%20AND%20description%3D%22large%20subunit%20ribosomal%20%22&"
      FIELDS="fields=accession%2Cscientific_name%2Chost%2Ccountry%2Ctax_id&"
      FORMAT="format=tsv"
      curl -s $PORTAL$RESULT$QUERY$FIELDS$FORMAT >> Genbank/INFO_accessions.txt
   ## COX1
      PORTAL="https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/portal/api/search?"
      RESULT="result=sequence&"
      QUERY="query=tax_tree(334452)%20AND%20description%3D%2228S%22&"
      FIELDS="fields=accession%2Cscientific_name%2Chost%2Ccountry%2Ctax_id&"
      FORMAT="format=tsv"
      curl -s $PORTAL$RESULT$QUERY$FIELDS$FORMAT | tail -n +2 >> Genbank/INFO_accessions.txt
      # if I do Coi and Cox1 at the same time add this | tail -n +2 
   fi
   BROWSER="https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/browser/api/fasta/"
   cut -f 1 Genbank/INFO_accessions.txt | tail -n +2 > Genbank/accessions.txt
   ACCESSIONS=$(gawk -v ORS="," '{print}' Genbank/accessions.txt |  sed 's/.$//' )
   curl -s $BROWSER$ACCESSIONS > Genbank/Crepi28SENA.fa
fi


```

# Edit and selecting the sequences of GenBank
```{r, collapse = TRUE, warning=FALSE}
suppressWarnings(library('DECIPHER'))
suppressWarnings(library('htmltools'))
suppressWarnings(library('stringr'))

## Edit the sequences of GenBank
Crepi28S <- readDNAStringSet("Genbank/Crepi28SENA.fa")

for (i in 1:length(names(Crepi28S))) {
  name <- paste0("C. ", strsplit(names(Crepi28S), " ")[[i]][3])
  accession <- substr(strsplit(names(Crepi28S), " ")[[i]][1], 5, 12)
  names(Crepi28S)[i] <- paste0(accession, " ", name)
}

## First round
### We try to remove those duplicated accessions and information
### Addittionally, create the .fa file for the tree test 
Crepi28S <- Crepi28S[-grep("sp.", names(Crepi28S), fixed = TRUE)]
info <- read.delim("Genbank/INFO_accessions.txt", header = TRUE)
rownames(info) <- info$accession

accessions <- character()
for (i in 1:length(names(Crepi28S))) {accessions[i] <- strsplit(names(Crepi28S), " ")[[i]][1]}
info <- info[accessions, ]

for (i in 1:length(names(Crepi28S))) {
  name <- paste0("C._", strsplit(names(Crepi28S), " ")[[i]][3])
  accession <- strsplit(names(Crepi28S), " ")[[i]][1]
  #host <- paste0(strsplit(info[accession, 3], " ")[[1]][1], "_", strsplit(info[accession, 3], " ")[[1]][2])
  country <- str_to_upper(substr(info[accession, 4], 1,2))
  if (country == "SW") { country <- "CH"}
  if (country == "UN") { country <- "UK"}
  names(Crepi28S)[i] <- paste0(accession, "_", name, "_", country)
}

writeXStringSet(Crepi28S, "Crepi28S_Edited.fa")
if (!dir.exists("RAxML")) {dir.create("RAxML")}
if (!dir.exists("RAxML/round00")) {dir.create("RAxML/round00")}
writeXStringSet(Crepi28S, "RAxML/round00/Seq_round00.fa")
```

```{bash}
FOLDER=RAxML/round00
if [ ! -e $FOLDER/AlignTree_Mafft.alg ]; then
  mafft --maxiterate 100 --thread 48 --localpair $FOLDER/Seq_round00.fa > $FOLDER/AlignTree_Mafft.alg
  raxml-ng --all --msa $FOLDER/AlignTree_Mafft.alg --model GTR+G --prefix $FOLDER/T1_10 --bs-trees 10 --threads 48
fi

```

```{r, FixNAMES_Pt2, collapse =TRUE}
suppressWarnings(library('DECIPHER'))
suppressWarnings(library('htmltools'))
suppressWarnings(library('stringr'))
suppressWarnings(library('phangorn'))

## Too many sequences, we search for those who are exactly identical
# with raxml, since it identifies the sequences that are 
# identical and creates a reduced phy without gaps and duplicates
phy <- read.phyDat("RAxML/round00/T1_10.raxml.reduced.phy")

acphy <- character()
for (i in 1:length(names(phy))) {acphy[i] <- strsplit(names(phy), "_")[[i]][1]}
## Remove those that are not in the reduced phy 
Origin <- readDNAStringSet("Crepi28S_Edited.fa")
Crepi28S <- DNAStringSet()
for (i in 1:length(acphy)) {
  Crepi28S[i] <- Origin[grep(acphy[i], names(Origin), fixed = TRUE)]
  if (strsplit(names(phy), "_")[[i]][1] == acphy[i]) {
    names(Crepi28S)[i] <- names(phy)[i]
  }
}
#BrowseSeqs(AlignSeqs(Crepi28S))

writeXStringSet(Crepi28S, "Crepi28S_Edited2.fa")
```


## Obtain the two outgroups for the phylogeny 
```{bash, collapse=TRUE}

# RESULT = Supported types are analysis,analysis_study,assembly,coding,noncoding,read_experiment,read_run,read_study,sample,sequence,study,taxon,tls_set,tsa_set,wgs_set

## Allocreadium neotenicum
if [ ! -e Genbank/accessionAN.txt ]; then
   PORTAL="https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/portal/api/search?"
   RESULT="result=sequence&"
   QUERY="query=accession=MH143104&"
   FIELDS="fields=accession%2Cscientific_name%2Chost%2Ccountry%2Ctax_id&"
   FORMAT="format=tsv"
   curl -s $PORTAL$RESULT$QUERY$FIELDS$FORMAT | \
   cut -f 1 | tail -n +2 > Genbank/accessionAN.txt
   curl -s $PORTAL$RESULT$QUERY$FIELDS$FORMAT | \
   tail -n +2 > Genbank/info_AN.txt
fi
BROWSER="https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/browser/api/fasta/"
ACCESSION=$(gawk -v ORS="," '{print}' Genbank/accessionAN.txt | sed 's/.$//' | cut -d ',' -f 1)
SP=$(cut -f 2 Genbank/info_AN.txt | sed "s/$(echo ' ')/_/g")
HOST=$(cut -f 3 Genbank/info_AN.txt | sed "s/$(echo ' ')/_/g")
COUNTRY=$(cut -f 4 Genbank/info_AN.txt | cut -c1-3 | awk '{print toupper($0)}')
if [ ! -e Genbank/$ACCESSION.fa ]; then
  curl -s $BROWSER$ACCESSION > Genbank/$ACCESSION.fa
  sed -i "/>/c >${ACCESSION}_${SP}" Genbank/${ACCESSION}.fa
fi
cat Genbank/${ACCESSION}.fa >> Outgroups.fa

## Cercariaeum crassum
if [ ! -e Genbank/accessionCC.txt ]; then
   PORTAL="https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/portal/api/search?"
   RESULT="result=sequence&"
   QUERY="query=accession=OQ359131&"
   FIELDS="fields=accession%2Cscientific_name%2Chost%2Ccountry%2Ctax_id&"
   FORMAT="format=tsv"
   curl -s $PORTAL$RESULT$QUERY$FIELDS$FORMAT | \
   cut -f 1 | tail -n +2 > Genbank/accessionCC.txt
   curl -s $PORTAL$RESULT$QUERY$FIELDS$FORMAT | \
   tail -n +2 > Genbank/info.txt
fi
BROWSER="https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/browser/api/fasta/"
ACCESSION=$(gawk -v ORS="," '{print}' Genbank/accessionCC.txt | sed 's/.$//' | cut -d ',' -f 1)
SP=$(cut -f 2 Genbank/info.txt | sed "s/$(echo ' ')/_/g")
HOST=$(cut -f 3 Genbank/info.txt | sed "s/$(echo ' ')/_/g")
COUNTRY=$(cut -f 4 Genbank/info.txt | cut -c1-3 | awk '{print toupper($0)}')
if [ ! -e Genbank/$ACCESSION.fa ]; then
  curl -s $BROWSER$ACCESSION > Genbank/$ACCESSION.fa
  sed -i "/>/c >${ACCESSION}_${SP}" Genbank/${ACCESSION}.fa
  #sed -i "/>/c >${ACCESSION}_${SP}\|\\${HOST}\|\\${COUNTRY}" ${ACCESSION}.fa
fi
cat Genbank/${ACCESSION}.fa >> Outgroups.fa

```

Done in 2023-06-22 folder.

```{r message=FALSE, collapse=TRUE}
markers <- readDNAStringSet("lsrDNA_RefGen2.fa")
names(markers)[1] <- "C._farionis_NO_Takvatn*"
writeXStringSet(markers[1], "lsrDNA_RefGen2.fa")
```

```{bash}
## Our sequences are so much longer than the ENA sequences, so first we align them with mafft, 
## and then we trim the alignment before execute RAxML

FOLDER=RAxML/round00
if [ ! -d RAxML ]; then mkdir RAxML; fi
if [ ! -d $FOLDER ]; then mkdir $FOLDER; fi
if [ ! -e $FOLDER/AlignTree_Mafft_01.alg ]; then
  mafft --maxiterate 1000 --thread 24 --localpair Seq28S_tree.fa > $FOLDER/AlignTree_Mafft_01.alg 
fi
```

## Trimm the alignment
```{r, collapse = TRUE}
if (file.exists("RAxML/round00/AlignTree_Mafft.alg") == FALSE) {
  Align <- readDNAStringSet("RAxML/round00/AlignTree_Mafft_01.alg")
  #BrowseSeqs(Align)
  #BrowseSeqs(subseq(Align, start = 100, end = 1119))
  Align <- subseq(Align, start = 100, end = 1119)
  writeXStringSet(Align, "RAxML/round00/AlignTree_Mafft.alg")
}
```

```{bash, collapse = TRUE}
FOLDER=RAxML/round00

if [ ! -e T1_1000.raxml.support ]; then 
  raxml-ng --all --msa $FOLDER/AlignTree_Mafft.alg --model GTR+G --prefix $FOLDER/T1_1000 --bs-trees 1000 --threads 48
fi
if [ ! -e $FOLDER/EvalMod_GTR+R4.raxml.log ]; then 
  for i in GTR+G GTR+R4 GTR JC JC+G; do
    raxml-ng --evaluate --msa $FOLDER/AlignTree_Mafft.alg --tree $FOLDER/T1_1000.raxml.bestTree --model ${i} --prefix $FOLDER/EvalMod_${i}
  done
fi
```

```{bash}
FOLDER=RAxML/round00
# Which model yields the highest log-likelihood? 
grep "logLikelihood" $FOLDER/EvalMod*
## The model is GTR+R4, but
# AIC/BIC scores (lower values are better)
grep "AIC" $FOLDER/EvalMod*
```

```{bash, collapse = TRUE, eval = FALSE}
FOLDER=RAxML/round00
## Finally run a tree Search
raxml-ng --msa $FOLDER/AlignTree_Mafft.alg --model GTR+R4 --prefix $FOLDER/T2 --threads 48 --redo

## Compute and map bootstrap support values to the best ML tree (S1.raxml.bestTree)
raxml-ng --bootstrap --msa $FOLDER/AlignTree_Mafft.alg --model GTR+R4 --prefix $FOLDER/S2_bestTree --tree $FOLDER/T2.raxml.bestTree --threads 48 --bs-trees 1000
# Recompute support values using the Transfer Bootstrap Expectation (TBE) algorithm. Did this change the support values?
raxml-ng --support --tree $FOLDER/T2.raxml.bestTree --bs-trees $FOLDER/S2_bestTree.raxml.bootstraps --prefix $FOLDER/S2_FBP --threads 48 --bs-metric fbp
raxml-ng --support --tree $FOLDER/T2.raxml.bestTree --bs-trees $FOLDER/S2_bestTree.raxml.bootstraps --prefix $FOLDER/S2_TBE --threads 48 --bs-metric tbe

```
